Boston Bike Party

Boston, MA · Back Bay · Social

No-drop

Boston Bike Party is a social group ride in Boston, MA. It rolls second Friday of the month at 7:00 pm from Copley Square. Pace: casual. No-drop.

First time? Here's the drill

Bring
a helmet, front and rear lights (it's a dark-hours ride), water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before 7:00 pm. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace
Pace: casual. It's no-drop: if you fall off the back, someone waits. That's the point of a group ride.
Check
Look at @bostonbikeparty the day of — that's where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the Boston Bike Party group ride

A monthly social group ride at a casual pace, volunteer-run and free. Around a thousand riders on a good night. Meets at Copley Square unless a post says otherwise. All ages, all bikes.
